verdict.rationale: Fedora's Workstation page says it ships the latest Red Hat container tools with no setup required, and describes high-efficiency tools for creating, running and managing containers. That matches the story directly, but it rests on marketing copy alone. Missing for 10: the specific container tools are never named or documented in depth, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that they work out of the box.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use container tools out of the box with no additional setup required

citations.quote: Use the latest container tools from the Red Hat ecosystem. No setup required.
